replies.author: suspector
replies.body:
Why should I? 
If you are just here to bitch, then leave the thread. I did what I did and I have no regrets at all, you'll understand why I did it when you experienced what I did.
If that is a genuine question, well I don't believe in joining an OCN team or making one. I could make one, a very successful one that that but there would be no benefit. This way I get to do multiple things, meet new people, learn new things, interact with the server more ands how people that OCN is not this one thing and I get to break the stereotype that OCN people do not have an interest in helping out and are just in it to win it.
